name: @loozo/origami-ui
description: Headless, accessible Angular primitives: collection, presence, collapsible, accordion, popover and toggle.
author: Theophilos Matzavinos

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ng-packagr -p ng-package.json -c tsconfig.lib.json && node ../../scripts/finish-package.mjs .
scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "Publish from dist/: pnpm build, then pnpm --dir dist publish" >&2 && exit 1
scripts.test: pnpm run acceptance:sync && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run snippets:check && pnpm run acceptance:typecheck && pnpm run acceptance:types && pnpm run acceptance:node
scripts.test:fast: pnpm run test && pnpm run acceptance:browser-readiness:fast && pnpm run acceptance:observer-calibration:fast && pnpm run acceptance:test:fast
scripts.test:focus: pnpm run acceptance:sync && pnpm run acceptance:test:fast
scripts.test:full: node tests/acceptance/matrix-summary.mjs --reset && pnpm run acceptance:prepare && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run snippets:check && pnpm run acceptance:typecheck && pnpm run acceptance:check && pnpm run acceptance:aot && pnpm run acceptance:bundles && pnpm run acceptance:browser-readiness && pnpm run acceptance:observer-calibration && ORIGAMI_PREBUILT=1 pnpm run acceptance:matrix
scripts.acceptance:check: pnpm run acceptance:package && pnpm run acceptance:types && pnpm run acceptance:docs && pnpm run acceptance:node
scripts.acceptance:aot: (cd .scratch/consumer && node ../../node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build consumer --configuration development-eager && node ../../node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build consumer --configuration development-incremental && node ../../node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build consumer --configuration production-eager && node ../../node_modules/@angular/cli/bin/ng.js build consumer --configuration production-incremental)
scripts.acceptance:matrix: node tests/acceptance/matrix-summary.mjs --reset && ORIGAMI_SUITE=product ORIGAMI_MATRIX_TARGET=development-eager pnpm run acceptance:test && ORIGAMI_SUITE=product ORIGAMI_MATRIX_TARGET=development-incremental pnpm run acceptance:test && ORIGAMI_SUITE=product ORIGAMI_MATRIX_TARGET=production-eager pnpm run acceptance:test && ORIGAMI_SUITE=product ORIGAMI_MATRIX_TARGET=production-incremental pnpm run acceptance:test && node tests/acceptance/matrix-summary.mjs
